snippet.title: Sonic the hedgehog in Giant jungle (Sonic hack) SHC 2024 Spotlight trailer
snippet.description:
Hi, if you've read the channels description you probably know that also make sonic hacks, not only music. This is my first hack and I plan to release it for SHC 2024, it is a short Sonic 1 hack meant for speedrunning, I'm trying to add lots of cool gimmicks to make the level design closer to Sonic 3 with its heavy use of them. Hope you like it! 

The song is a reimagination of Friends by Hyperpotion, it uses the same chord but with some different melodies and different instruments.


Sorry for not uploading this last week, I've been working on this, I will upload the rejected songs I was going to use for this trailer but that just didn't fit.
